info.title: ALbuild CLI
info.description: A thin, cross-platform command-line face for the ALbuild Business Central toolchain. The `albuild` CLI is an MCP client over the businessdev.ALbuild PowerShell module: containers, artifacts, build/publish/test, dependency resolution, code coverage and test quality, plus MCP lifecycle tooling — one stable verb surface for humans, CI and AI agents.
